user_problem: Approved audience profiles and messages need matching without inventing motivations or market behavior.
unique_output: A fit table linking each supplied need to message, evidence, disqualifier, permitted CTA, and unresolved gap.
required_input: Audience profiles, approved needs, message library, evidence notes, exclusions, and allowed calls to action.
critical_rule: Use only stated audience attributes and needs; never infer sensitive traits, intent, or likely conversion.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is landing-page-message-sequencer; this matches messages to supplied profiles rather than ordering one page narrative.
acceptance_scenario: Input profile P1 needs offline export, message M1 promises supplied CSV export evidence E1, CTA 'View export guide'; M2 concerns collaboration. Output matches M1 to P1 and leaves M2 unmatched.
